title: Critical Incident Escalation
briefing: A security monitoring system detects suspicious lateral movement across several internal servers. You must decide quickly how to respond.

feedback.Ignore the alert: Incorrect. Ignoring signs of lateral movement allows attackers to expand their foothold and increase operational impact.
feedback.Investigate the alert: Partially correct. Investigation is important, but delaying containment may allow the attacker to continue moving across systems.
feedback.Immediately isolate affected systems: Correct. Rapid containment limits attacker mobility and reduces the potential for wider compromise.
